$comment: Single source of truth for numeric constants that MUST stay identical across
multiple protocol or UI surfaces. This includes the agent transcript timing
constants and the device WebSocket protocol version.
Each surface carries the value in its own native unit (the portal + Android in
milliseconds, iOS in seconds or nanoseconds). The canonical value here is in
MILLISECONDS; scripts/check-parity.mjs normalises each surface's literal to ms
Marker convention: at each surface's single canonical declaration of a key,
place a trailing `// PARITY:<key>` comment on the SAME line as the literal,
check-parity.mjs extracts the first numeric literal on the marked line, so a
hand-edit that diverges a value is caught — it does not merely trust this table.
Fail-loud: a key with no marker in a surface it lists, a marker naming an
unknown key, or a value mismatch all exit non-zero.
On a protocol/schema/timing change: edit the literal in every listed source file AND the
canonical value here in the same commit, or the guard reddens.

ephemeral-reveal-ms.description: Per-item cadence + slot slide duration for the agent ephemeral rolling-slot cards.

ephemeral-hold-ms.description: Quiet pause after the last rotated item before the card begins collapsing.

ephemeral-fade-ms.description: Fade-out duration when an ephemeral card dismisses.

ephemeral-min-visible-ms.description: Minimum time an ephemeral card stays visible before its fade-out can begin.

tell-omnesis-pending-warning-ms.description: Age at which a locally queued Tell Omnesis note surfaces a delivery warning.

agent-return-window-ms.description: Maximum background age for restoring the exact active Ask surface.

device-ws-protocol-version.description: Device WebSocket hello protocol version shared by the gateway contract and native clients.
